task.ques: Locate a travel guide book on Amazon for Japan, published in 2024, with at least 20 customer reviews.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Lonely Planet Japan: Comprehensive Travel Guide, paperback, published April 2, 2024, has 987 customer reviews on Amazon (4.3/5 stars), exceeding the required 20 reviews.
Source: https://www.amazon.com/dp/1838693726
Evidence: final.png shows the title, review count, and publication date together.
